Mechanical keyboard for iphone

Illustration·by @LynelDesign·2026-08-24·inspora page·original post

What it is

Mechanical keyboard for iPhone (illustration): a 3D-rendered iOS-style soft keyboard - prediction bar ('The', the, to), white sculpted keycaps with deep rounding and soft shadows, blue return key, emoji/mic row; close-up shows glossy bezel curvature. Keys depress with a mechanical-style travel when tapped.

Build prompt

Rebuild these static renders 1:1, pixel-faithful: a mechanical keyboard for iPhone (illustration) - a 3D-rendered iOS-style soft keyboard plus a macro close-up of the glossy bezel curvature.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - every value is plain layout/typography/CSS; recreate with your own components and assets.

## Layout
Render 1: full keyboard on a pale backdrop - prediction bar ("The", the, to) above, 3 key rows + modifiers, emoji/mic in the bottom tray. Render 2: macro shot of the bottom-left corner - chrome-grey bezel curve, emoji key, ABC/shift keys.

## Content & materials
White sculpted keycaps, chunky with 8px radius, top-lit with soft shadows under each cap and ambient occlusion in the gaps; one consistent light source. Blue return key (only color accent) with a slight glow. Glossy materials, seam lines, and cap legends visible in the macro. Prediction bar flat and quiet.

## States
Static renders. Optional micro-interaction if built live: keycap presses translateY 2px + shadow tighten, 80ms down / 120ms spring release.

## Don't miss
- The 3D read comes from under-cap shadows + AO in the gaps, not gradients on cap faces.
- 8px radius and chunky proportions are the iOS-mechanical hybrid look.
- Macro shot must show the bezel's glossy curvature and seam lines - the materials are the subject.
